thread:
Kyla H.: Hi all! First day — thanks for the warm welcome. My monitor and dock arrived but I'm stuck: the dock powers the display but my USB keyboard and mouse don't show up when plugged into the dock. Also trying to join CompanyCorp-Enterprise wifi prompts for a client certificate I don't have. Opened ticket IT-5123. Any quick checks?

Ravi (IT): welcome Kyla! Quick checks: 1) are the keyboard/mouse USB-A or USB-C? 2) try another downstream port on the dock and reboot the host with the dock connected. 3) paste output of `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` (Mac) or `lsusb` (Linux).

Kyla H.: They're USB-A. I rebooted with dock connected, still nothing. Mac output (trimmed):
```
Thunderbolt Bus:
  Aurora Dock v1.1:
    Current Available (mA): 9000
```
Looks like the dock only advertises 9A?

Ravi (IT): OK that explains peripheral issues — looks like PD negotiated to low power which can disable some hub functions. Two quick routes: 1) try a different USB-C cable (some are charge-only), 2) I can ship a prepped 100W USB-C cable + USB-A hub for now. Also for the wifi cert: go to Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll Device, that will install the machine cert. If enrollment errors, reply and I'll push a token.

Priya S.: fwiw I had a dock that advertised low mA until I used a full-power cable; seconding the cable swap.

Kyla H.: Remote in Austin — shipping cable + hub would be great. Thanks!

it-bot: Ticket IT-5123 updated by Ravi (IT): "Shipping 100W USB-C cable + USB-A hub; device enrollment instructions provided."

Ravi (IT): Placed overnight kit: 1x USB-C 100W cable, 1x USB 3.0 hub, 1x short USB-Ethernet dongle. Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1ZABC0001234567890 ETA 1 business day. I'll leave the ticket open until you confirm enrollment and peripherals work.

Kyla H.: Thanks so much 60a I'll try the enrollment flow now and update when the kit arrives. Appreciate the quick help!
